note: Norton city's zoning page links a current zoning map, which appears to be a static map rather than a queryable service; the city's GIS viewer (nortonva.interactivegis.com) is a login-gated iGIS app that names no public ArcGIS REST zoning layer. The only Zoning_Districts service found (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) returns no features inside Norton's bounding box, so it is not Norton's.
